evidence_quotes: The 2019 extradition amendment bill was **withdrawn**, not enacted. It never became law.
rows.rationale: Substantively corrects the central enactment-versus-withdrawal error: the bill was withdrawn and never became law. It conflates the September 4 announcement with formal October withdrawal. Primary fate-correction credit is preserved while recording the date error as auxiliary; strict compound-reference alternative is incorrect. This does not certify the whole chronology.
